varieties.name: Tillandsia ionantha
varieties.note: The common small one: a dense spiky rosette a few centimetres across. Blushes red at the centre before flowering. Tolerant, and the easiest to start with.

varieties.name: Tillandsia caput-medusae
varieties.note: Swollen hollow base with thick snaking leaves. The bulb traps water, so shake it out and dry it upside down or it rots from the inside.

varieties.name: Tillandsia bulbosa
varieties.note: Bulbous base, narrow twisting leaves. Wants more humidity than most, and has the same trapped-water risk as caput-medusae.

varieties.name: Tillandsia xerographica
varieties.note: Large silver rosette with broad curling leaves. Heavily trichomed, so it is the most drought-tolerant and the easiest to overwater.

varieties.name: Tillandsia juncea
varieties.note: Upright grassy tuft. Open form, dries quickly, forgiving about soaking time.

varieties.name: Tillandsia stricta
varieties.note: Soft dense rosette, free-flowering with a pink bract. Thinner trichomes mean it dries out faster and wants watering more often.

varieties.name: Tillandsia butzii
varieties.note: Mottled purple-green bulb with wiry leaves. Prefers higher humidity and shade.

varieties.name: Unidentified
varieties.note: Sold unlabelled, as most air plants are. Treat as ionantha until it flowers, which is usually what identifies it.

moisture_percent.label: Tissue hydration (no root zone — a soil probe does not apply)

watering.label: Soak 20–30 min, then shake out and dry upside down in moving air within 4 h

drainage.label: No substrate. Water must leave the crown and any bulb cavity fast; standing water there is the usual cause of death

established: Too dark. It stretches, loses its blush, and will not flower.
Dim. Colour stays flat green and growth almost stops.
A little short. It holds, but slowly and without colouring up.
Burning. Leaves bleach to straw-white and dry from the tips.
Too much. With no roots to buffer it, damage shows quickly.
Far too much. The plant dries out faster than misting can answer.
